subject: Auth first server-list wait and game content-ready admission; cover feedback deployment
defect: The game server previously accepted/authenticated clients before MissionContentManager loaded; a fast switch entered boot camp without its private instance. Moving game admission after initialization exposed a second race: Auth could answer ServerListExt while no game server was registered. The recovered client showed a persistent No servers found modal, even after automatic world entry (isolated derived-feedback-readiness-24 screenshot).
implementation: Game.Server.Start now accepts world clients and connects to Auth after all startup managers. Auth.Client defers only the first empty ServerListExt response for at most 20 seconds, allowing the existing game-registration broadcast to satisfy it; subsequent refreshes remain immediate. Empty broadcasts do not reset the deadline. After the bounded wait, Auth sends the current empty list if Game is still unavailable.
isolated_verification: In auth-server-list-wait-25, client Login at 19:21:48.920 and ServerListExt at 19:21:49.852 preceded Game content readiness at 19:21:57.190 and Game auth registration at 19:21:57.291. Auth then received AboutToPlay at 19:21:57.486; Game created private instance 2 for character 1 at 19:22:01.874 and received MapLoaded at 19:22:14.593. Original-client world-after-entry.png has no No servers found modal. This diagnostic used a copied server/world with 410 content rows and 3 unrelated validation gaps; live world content has 404 rows and 0 gaps.

deployment.method: Derived from immediately preceding live images, overlaying only Auth/Client.cs, Auth/Server.cs, Game/Server.cs and the five reviewed cover feedback source files. Built both images with dotnet build --no-restore. Backed up rasaauth.db, rasachar.db and rasaworld.db using SQLite backup API; each backup passed integrity_check. Tagged previous images, updated latest tags, and recreated only auth and game using docker compose up --no-build -d auth game.
deployment.verification: At 00:25:49.705 UTC live Game loaded 17 rules/404 rows/0 gaps, then opened the world listener at 00:25:49.758 and connected to Auth at 00:25:49.772; Auth authenticated server 234 at 00:25:49.793. Both containers remained running with zero restarts; all three live SQLite databases passed integrity_check after restart. The recovered 1.16.5.0 client logged into live Auth via VPS Tailscale 100.104.53.1:2116, sent ServerListExt and AboutToPlay, and displayed Character Select for the public test account at 00:26 UTC.

status: Deployed and tested with an isolated public test account; the owner MacBook login after deployment is unobserved.
limitations: The 20-second startup wait is an emulator availability fix, not a proven final-live auth timeout. The server-side cover sample grid and factor assignment remain labelled inference. Live player cover feedback has not been observed from the owner account.
